syllabus_topics: Overview of Matlab and Simulink in examples; Essentials of signal processing toolbox
Classification of signals; Deterministic and stochastic; Harmonic signals
Introduction to spectral analysis of signals; Signal frequency components; Bode diagrams.
Fourier series representation of periodic signals; Fourier transform; Inverse Fourier Transform.
Nyquist sampling theorem; DFT; FFT and its application.
Convolution of continuous and discrete signals; Deconvolution; Parseval theorem; Application to system identification.
Laplace transform and its use in the analysis of continuous-time systems.
Signal processing in mechanical systems; Drilling, cutting and rolling processes; Chattering phenomenon analysis.
Spectral analysis in control loop; Relay feedback test; Stability and robustness.
Analog filter design, classification and applications; Ultimate frequency assessment; Biosignal shaping.
z-transform and its use in the analysis of discrete-time systems.
Signal modulation and demodulation; Scaling and rescaling.
bibliography: E. W. Kamen and B. S. Heck: Fundamentals of Signals and Systems (2nd Edition), Prentice Hall, 2006
H. Kwakernaak and R. Sivan: Modern Signals and Systems, Prentice Hall, 1990
Klan, P., Gorez, R.: Process control. FCC Public, Prague, 2011
Electronic materials to the lectures downloadable from http://moodle.fs.cvut.cz
